segments.text: 3 Then were brought the golden veſſels that were taken out of the temple of the Lordes houſe at Ieruſalem, and the kyng and his princes, hys wiues and his concubines dranke in them.
4 They dranke wine and prayſed the Gods of gold and ſiluer, of braſſe, of yron, of wood, and of ſtone.
